Package game.actors.boss

Class Branch

java.lang.Object
game.actors.boss.BossPart
game.actors.boss.Branch
All Implemented Interfaces:
BossPartInterface, Growable
public class Branch extends BossPart implements Growable
Represents a branch part of the Bed of Chaos boss tree. Branches can grow by randomly adding either another branch or a leaf as a child. Each branch contributes 3 attack bonus and 0 healing.
